memories.content: The German Foreign Office is the recipient of diplomatic communications. It operates during normal business hours and has protocols for receiving official notes from foreign ambassadors. It is aware of the ultimatum and the general diplomatic tensions.

The date is July 23, 1914. Diplomatic tensions are high following the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand. France and Germany are in a crisis. The German ultimatum expires on July 28, 1914. Ambassador Dupont has a protest note to deliver to the German Foreign Office.

He is aware of the ultimatum's expiration on July 28, 1914, and intends to deliver the note before that deadline.
